::: {.section-intro}
UlavalSSD supports introductory data science, including STT-1100. It provides historical snapshots of Quebec data and teaching tools that can be used offline after installation.
:::

CRAN version: 0.3.1, published on October 2, 2026.

::: {.link-list}
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=UlavalSSD){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
[GitHub](https://github.com/AurelienNicosiaULaval/UlavalSSD){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
[STT-1100](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/STT-1100_notes_de_cours/){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
:::

## Teaching content

- Historical weather observations from Quebec.
- Historical food-establishment conviction records.
- Bilingual prompts and feedback for a data-cleaning exercise.
- An optional R code-style diagnostic using `lintr`.

These data support practice with import, missing values, exploration and reproducible reports. The [repository](https://github.com/AurelienNicosiaULaval/UlavalSSD) documents provenance and limitations; the snapshots do not describe current establishments or weather conditions.

## Installation

Install the released version directly from CRAN:

```r
install.packages("UlavalSSD")
```

The [GitHub repository](https://github.com/AurelienNicosiaULaval/UlavalSSD) contains the development source and additional installation guidance.

Public sources checked on October 5, 2026.
